summary: Monolith: Django + Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL serving Server-rendered templates + HTMX, hosted on Google Cloud Run (us-central1 Iowa). Estimated $9-40/month (around the $20 budget).

architecture_rationale.text: A single deployable is the fastest and cheapest option for a 1-person team building a internal_tool with 50 users. Over-engineering guard: microservices rejected: 1 engineer(s), no DevOps cannot absorb the operational overhead.

frontend.justification: Web - Server-rendered templates + HTMX: Chosen because team already works in python (team.languages); strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=5; strong time-to-market (4/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5; form-heavy CRUD screens render well on the server.

alternatives.why_not: No javascript/typescript in team.languages: ramp-up time and hiring risk (fit 3.8 vs 8.7).
No javascript/typescript in team.languages: ramp-up time and hiring risk. Server-rendered templates + HTMX scores higher on learning curve (fit 3.3 vs 8.7).

tradeoffs: Rich offline/canvas-style interactivity still needs JavaScript islands
UI and backend deploy together (fine for one team)

backend.justification: Chosen because team already works in python (team.languages); strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5; strong maintainability (5/5) with priorities.maintainability=3; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3.

alternatives.why_not: Django scores higher on time-to-market and maintainability (fit 9.2 vs 10.3).
No csharp/fsharp in team.languages: ramp-up time and hiring risk. Django scores higher on time-to-market and platform coverage (fit 4.9 vs 10.3).

database.justification: Chosen because relational integrity and transactions for a internal_tool domain; strong maintainability (5/5) with priorities.maintainability=3; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3; strong cost efficiency (4/5) with priorities.cost=5. Managed as Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL: same platform and private network as the application hosting; fully managed: no operations work for a team without DevOps.

alternatives.why_not: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL scores higher on maintainability and security (fit 6.2 vs 6.9).
Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL scores higher on integration with the hosting platform (fit 1.2 vs 2.2).
Excluded by hard constraint: deployment_model=managed_cloud: self-managed VMs/databases are excluded in favour of managed services.

tradeoffs: Single-writer primary: write scale beyond one large node needs partitioning/sharding
Vacuum and connection pooling need attention at scale
Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL starts around $9/month against a $20/month total budget

hosting.justification: Chosen because strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=5; strong scalability (5/5) with priorities.scalability=3; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3; strong time-to-market (4/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5.

alternatives.why_not: Google Cloud Run scores higher on cost and scalability (fit 7.4 vs 7.9).
Google Cloud Run scores higher on cost and scalability (fit 7.4 vs 7.9).
Excluded by hard constraint: deployment_model=managed_cloud is not on-premise.

tradeoffs: Session affinity is best-effort for stateful rooms

supporting.justification: Chosen because strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=5; auth inside the backend; no per-MAU fees; free tier fits budget.monthly_infra_usd=20; strong time-to-market (4/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5.

alternatives.why_not: Django auth + django-allauth scores higher on cost and authentication fit (fit 4.0 vs 5.1).
Weaker cost efficiency (2/5) with priorities.cost=5. Django auth + django-allauth scores higher on authentication fit (fit 3.7 vs 5.1).

tradeoffs: You own password storage, rate limiting and MFA flows

supporting.justification: Chosen because strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=5; strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5; free minutes, large action marketplace, works with any cloud; free tier fits budget.monthly_infra_usd=20.

alternatives.why_not: Different cloud from the application hosting. GitHub Actions scores higher on time-to-market and cost (fit 2.4 vs 6.4).
GitLab CI (self-managed) starts around $10/month against a $20/month total budget; self-hosting CI is unnecessary. GitHub Actions scores higher on time-to-market (fit -1.5 vs 6.4).

supporting.justification: Chosen because same cloud/platform and region as the application; strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5; free tier fits budget.monthly_infra_usd=20; strong scalability (5/5) with priorities.scalability=3.

alternatives.why_not: Google Cloud Logging + Monitoring scores higher on integration with the hosting platform and scalability (fit 5.1 vs 7.5).
Different cloud from the application hosting (fit 3.0 vs 7.5).

supporting.justification: Chosen because strong time-to-market (5/5) with priorities.time_to_market=5; free tier fits budget.monthly_infra_usd=20; strong cost efficiency (4/5) with priorities.cost=5; strong maintainability (4/5) with priorities.maintainability=3.

alternatives.why_not: Different cloud from the application hosting. Resend scores higher on time-to-market (fit 3.0 vs 4.3).
In-network SMTP relay. Resend scores higher on time-to-market and maintainability (fit 0.9 vs 4.3).
